summary.text: Hamilton Grant is a Democratic state representative from Richland County who has represented South Carolina House District 79 since November 2024 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
A financial consultant, Grant serves on the Education and Public Works Committee and is secretary and treasurer of the Operations and Management Committee.

paragraphs.text: Grant earned a B.S. from South Carolina State University in 2011 and an M.B.A. from Alabama A&M University.
His legislative biography lists his work as a financial consultant and a Business Monthly Family-Owned Business of the Year recognition.
He is a member of Omega Psi Phi Fraternity and 100 Black Men of America.
Grant took office on November 11, 2024, succeeding Ivory Thigpen.
Ballotpedia lists him as the only candidate in the November 3 general election for the seat.
